causalConclusion: SceneKit shadow rasterization is the remaining nondeterministic stage. With shadows disabled as the sole independent variable, North and East are exactly deterministic across three fresh Metal-visible processes, and each converges to one of the two identities already emitted intermittently by the current-shadow path.
